items.note: S1.1.1-S1.1.5 follow the proof at 741-765 exactly (old scratch cancelled, net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, three-stage composition to (-y,x)). The statement is loose: it says 'three such invocations', whereas each stage has v^2 invocations along coordinate j and stage 2 runs the inverse schedule Y to X. It also never gives h=100, the neighbour rules (|S∩T|=1 for bit, even intersection for complex) or the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783).

Frames D_v shared by all incidences of a gate, edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, the invariant 'stored = D_v applied to logical', commutation by R-linearity, and the route formula ε_w D_sink(ρ(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} all match 793-825.

These steps state the labels in F^{⊗3}, the terminal labels, the stage transitions, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, the only decreasing edges (centre 3 to 4, loss h), L/N=100/539 and 101/539, and the orthonormal-basis fact. The telescoping argument (1066-1071) is reproduced. But the gate-label table (eq:motif-labels, 975-988; A⊗F on the X bank, B⊗F on the Y bank) and the per-edge residual table (1021-1043) are only named or quoted. Those tables are what establish nestedness and the single loss of h. Conservative verdict: partial.

These steps match the proof at 1156-1172: P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and the endpoint differences P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m and 0 to I. The shear frames Φ_M and H←H+D on every role appear in S2.2.3-S2.2.4.

The plan states one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, C^{⊗m} on every role, and the Z-conjugation repair of the 27 inverse factors. It never defines the phase frame C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{q_U(x)})H^{⊗m} with q_U=wt(P_Ux) mod 4, and it omits the k-column tensor form. The core mechanism at 1232-1257 is also missing: weight is additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, so q_V-q_U is a sum over the basis, and Hadamard conjugation turns the character (-1)^{v·x} into the translation X_v.

L/N<1/2 gives the deficit N-2L_b>0 (s_b<W_b m), and s_c<W_c m is also stated. The deficits η exceed 20·2^{-50} and log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-η) and s/W<m^τ with τ=σ=1-2^{-50}, as at 1331-1344. The exact η values (1321-1324) are not quoted, but the inequality chain is complete.

The plan invokes the controlled-shifts lemma for triangular updates (S2.1.2), the cyclic row split (S2.2.1) and whole-chunk cyclic shifts (S3.2.3), but it never states Lemma lem:elementary-streams or lem:ordered-affine-streams or their O(V) bounds as results.

The steps follow the paper: A=E_1ΠE_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, triangular transforms in O(V) via controlled shifts, the sandwich order, and D_j←D_j+H_i, swap, D_j←H_i-D_j giving exactly a interchanges. The statement omits the hypothesis that q is a fixed odd prime avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators of the factor table (1397, 1413-1423), which the specialization to Z/q^b needs.

The plan follows the paper step by step. Rows are split cyclically into W role streams, each edge applies Φ_{A_e} by a recursive matrix shear, and the frame identity gives Φ_{I_m}. The merge undoes ρ, and D←D-H, H←H+D, D←H-D swaps the chunks. The node makes s calls on volume V/W, so F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum gives O(e^τ), and the depth-first parking schedule keeps the work on fixed tapes.

The steps match 1649-1762: high digits form a row field with R=q^{2ρ}≥W^k, zero rows pad R'<2R, and base-m pieces cost O(V)Σa_j m^{jτ}=O(Ve^τ). Binary ranges are padded to [q^e], and widths differing by one bit are handled. The exact formula for ρ is omitted (not essential).

Also missing: why S_0(B)=B, so that T_0S_0^{-1} permutes B (2107-2114). S3.2.8 only quotes the cost.

errors.says: For triple indicator vectors ⟨t_S,t_T⟩=|S∩T|-1, so neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal in the label field of either construction (the S1.3 method makes the same claim).
errors.paper: The pairing |S∩T|-1 is for the rational form x^T(I-J/9)y of the bit network. The complex network uses F=F_2^h with the ordinary dot product, where t_S·t_T=|S∩T| mod 2 vanishes for its even-intersection neighbours. Read mod 2, |S∩T|-1 would be nonzero for those neighbours.

errors.says: three such invocations exchange the two banks as (X_a,Y_a)↦(-Y_a,X_a)
errors.paper: There are three stages, each made of v^2 invocations varying coordinate j. Stages 1 and 3 run the forward schedule X to Y; stage 2 runs the inverse forward schedule from Y to X. S1.1.5 later states this correctly.

errors.says: The normalized ring convolution has error below E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL and its output has norm below .701.
errors.paper: The norm bound .701 holds only when one operand has norm at most .7, by bilinear contraction.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: rank-saving networks (S1), then fast interchange (S2) and the simultaneous layer (S3), then synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S4), resampling with retained permutations (S5), assembly with exact recovery (S6), and parameter balance with κ=2^{-182} (S7). The bit-side saving chain is fully explicit. It thins on the complex side: the weight-additivity mechanism behind the phase kernels, the guard-width depth recurrence, the K≤e^{c/β} step in the layer recurrence, and the chunk-swap implementation of packed additions are only quoted. The network constants h=100, N and m are never given.

steps.note: The fixed linear network, its exchange (X_a,Y_a)↦(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and the triple indexing (U_a=t_{a1}⊗t_{a2}⊗t_{a3}) are all present. The numerical choices h=100, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated, although N and m are used.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs only a change of frame.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3 to 4 edges decreasing, each by h. The gate-label table itself is only named.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, with the N negative source edges 2P_{U_a} as the rank-one exceptions.
Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, then s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, both with the telescoping reason.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm.
M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, including auxiliary ones, so Φ_{I_m} gives H←H+D on every row.
A=E_1ΠE_2 with exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so the number of recursive calls equals the rational rank and a node makes s calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), η>20·2^{-50} and log m<20 giving s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum giving F_k=O(e^τ).

central.summary: All nine links of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content and in their chain roles: network, frames, labels, rank equals dimension change, the budget Wm-N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity I_m, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. The only gap is in C1: the constants h=100, N and m are never written down.
